name: Iraq
note: Iraq in the style of the Russian model tree: the established order in each period (the Ba'athist state under sanctions until 2003, then the new constitutional state) as the historical path, and alternatives led by real parties of the data (Islamist, liberal, communist, Kurdish regionalist, social-democratic) plus a junta; branches for the sanctions era, the new state, the war with the Islamic State from 2014, oil and economy, the army and foreign policy. Sourced starting spirits in data/spirits/irq.json, decisions in data/decisions/irq.json. Wars stay in the scripted conflict events. Alternatives are a counterfactual, not a claim about the parties.

focuses.name: Who rules Iraq
focuses.description: Which force leads Iraq: the ruling party, or one of the movements of the opposition.

focuses.name: The established order
focuses.description: Iraq is governed as it historically was in each period: by the Ba'ath Party until 2003, then by the coalitions of the new constitution.
